model.children: Stored children are adjacent halves. Evolution uses the overlapping triple (left, middle, right) so the next-level centre of width W/2 after W/4 steps is determined.
model.result: centre W/2 cells after W/4 steps, cached on the interned node
model.cache: empty at the start of each n; no precomputed spacetime dictionary
model.padding: initial word width 4n so one result() jump is exactly n steps

cost_model.comparisons: one key comparison per intern lookup, included in intern_lookup, reported separately and not added again

verdict.n_32768_note: Prior attempt at n=2^15 ran >40 min, entered disk sleep at ~1.5 GiB RSS, and never printed a result. Not rerun.
